app.title: A single function Jev-like wrapper for LLMs, including vision models
app.author: allanrbo
app.description: A one‑liner wrapper that exposes Jev‑style decision logic for any LLM, with optional vision support via embeddings.

proposed_tests.step:
python - <<'PY'
from jev_wrapper import wrapper
print(wrapper('gpt-4o', 'What is 2+2?'))
PY

python - <<'PY'
from jev_wrapper import wrapper
print(wrapper('gpt-4o', 'Describe this image', image='path/to/img.png'))
PY
